correctness.rationale: PASS. Ind_2(P) denotes subsets of ten graph vertices with all induced vertex degrees <=1, equivalently forbidden three-vertex paths, not two-matchings of graph edges. Independently enumerated all 2^10 subsets and got 260 nonempty faces, (10,45,90,80,30,5); independently generated the prescribed toggle matching with 129 pairs, critical masks 1 and 402 (0-,3-cells), and exhaustively topologically sorted 860 Hasse arrows confirming acyclicity. Forman yields a single 0-cell and 3-cell, hence S3. Nonpurity with five facets in dimensions 3 and 5 does not prevent this homotopy equivalence. No PL sphere or larger family inference.
